feature_policy: independent feature_received_at_ms; verified nonfuture quote <=2s and REST features <=5s; immutable pre-horizon capture
split: 21 chronological train days, 7 calibration days, 8 untouched test days; global purge by physical label availability

development_search.selection: lowest mean fold MAE; exact ties select larger ridge; train-only standardization; zero and training-mean baselines mandatory; no test-driven retries

uncertainty: 95% nominal chronological calibration absolute residual radius; calibration cannot change features or hyperparameters
cost_model: captured complete ExecutionCostModel parameters; fixed 10 USDT research notional; canonical BUY and SELL fee, spread, slippage and impact; midpoint denominator; strict 1.5x cost cushion
holdout_policy: Reserve future absolute dates and unique identity in ProjectDatabase at registration. Readiness sees metadata only. Fit/select on development only. Before evaluation consume the reserved range once in alpha_holdout_consumption. Failures remain consumed. Earlier observed shadow diagnostics and the failed legacy holdout are ineligible as final OOS.
promotion_policy: Successful validation still requires reviewed immutable artifact binding; readiness has no promotion or execution authority. A failed development candidate may produce no model.
